title: fix: consistent polli help colors
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Apply the existing help styles to every subcommand, including nested harness commands. No new dependencies.
- Preserve help text, plain/piped output and JSON behavior.
- Bump @pollinations/cli to 0.1.16.
- Verified: 147 tests, build, formatting, and built-CLI color/plain/JSON checks. Standalone typecheck has the same 33 existing diagnostics as unchanged main; no new errors.

gist.headline: Every command gets the good paint
gist.blurb: Polli's CLI help now wears the same colors all the way down the command tree. Even the nested harness commands have stopped freelancing their wardrobe.
gist.summary: Updated @pollinations/cli to 0.1.16 so the existing styled help output is applied consistently to every subcommand, including nested harness commands, while preserving plain, piped, and JSON output behavior.
gist.impact: CLI users now get the same readable colored help experience across the full command tree, with non-interactive and JSON workflows continuing to behave as before.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy command-line garden where each branching command path has matching lime-green help signposts. Polli, wearing tiny terminal-green reading glasses, carefully paints the final nested sign to match the rest; a small retro CRT terminal shows a neat command tree, with flowers and code-vines growing around it.
